notice: Organizational reference model, not universal legal obligations, qualification requirements or access permissions. Titles may be combined or outsourced. Statutory roles need jurisdiction-specific source review.

functions.label: Leadership & governance
functions.description: Oversee the PV operating model, escalations and continuity.

functions.label: Case operations
functions.description: Manage intake, processing, follow-up and delivery controls.

functions.label: Medical review & case quality
functions.description: Assess medical content and case quality.

functions.label: Clinical safety
functions.description: Coordinate safety oversight for clinical development.

functions.label: Signal detection & management
functions.description: Evaluate safety evidence and manage signal decisions.

functions.label: Benefit–risk & aggregate reporting
functions.description: Integrate safety evidence into assessments and reports.

functions.label: Risk management
functions.description: Plan, implement and assess risk controls.

functions.label: Epidemiology & real-world evidence
functions.description: Design and interpret population-level safety studies.

functions.label: Regulatory intelligence & policy
functions.description: Monitor sources and assess reporting requirements.

functions.label: Labeling & product information
functions.description: Assess and track safety information changes.

functions.label: Quality & compliance
functions.description: Maintain quality oversight and improvement evidence.

functions.label: PSMF & local PV
functions.description: Maintain system descriptions and local interfaces.

functions.label: Partners & outsourcing
functions.description: Allocate and oversee shared PV activities.

functions.label: Safety systems & configuration
functions.description: Maintain controlled safety technology and integrations.

functions.label: Data & technology assurance
functions.description: Maintain data integrity and controlled technology changes.

functions.label: Training & knowledge
functions.description: Maintain controlled procedures and competency support.

roles.label: QPPV
roles.responsibility: Oversight of the PV system within the applicable jurisdiction

roles.label: Deputy / backup QPPV
roles.responsibility: Maintain documented backup arrangements and continuity

roles.label: Head of PV / VP Drug Safety
roles.responsibility: Set safety strategy, resources and escalation priorities

roles.label: PV governance lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate governance decisions and follow-through

roles.label: Safety operations manager
roles.responsibility: Oversee delivery, resourcing, performance and service interfaces

roles.label: PV associate / drug safety associate
roles.responsibility: Receive and triage safety information under controlled procedures

roles.label: Case processor / PV officer
roles.responsibility: Process cases, write narratives and coordinate follow-up

roles.label: PV executive
roles.responsibility: Support operational processing and database quality activities

roles.label: Follow-up coordinator
roles.responsibility: Coordinate outstanding information requests and follow-up records

roles.label: Safety physician / medical reviewer
roles.responsibility: Review medical information and document clinical judgments within assigned scope

roles.label: ICSR quality specialist
roles.responsibility: Check case quality, consistency and review findings

roles.label: Clinical safety scientist
roles.responsibility: Review emerging trial safety information and coordinate scientific follow-up

roles.label: Clinical safety physician
roles.responsibility: Provide clinical safety assessment and escalation within program governance

roles.label: Clinical operations safety liaison
roles.responsibility: Coordinate study-team safety handoffs and readiness

roles.label: Signal detection analyst
roles.responsibility: Analyze surveillance outputs and investigate potential signals

roles.label: Signal scientist
roles.responsibility: Evaluate evidence and support documented signal assessments

roles.label: Signal management lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate signal lifecycle, decisions and escalation

roles.label: Safety scientist / PV scientist
roles.responsibility: Synthesize safety evidence and support scientific assessments

roles.label: Benefit–risk lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate integrated benefit–risk evaluations and governance

roles.label: Aggregate report lead
roles.responsibility: Plan periodic report production, review and delivery

roles.label: Medical writer (PV)
roles.responsibility: Author and reconcile scientific safety documents

roles.label: Risk management specialist / RMP lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate risk-management plans and implementation needs

roles.label: REMS specialist
roles.responsibility: Coordinate applicable REMS activities and evidence

roles.label: Risk-minimisation specialist
roles.responsibility: Assess risk-minimisation implementation and effectiveness

roles.label: Pharmacoepidemiologist
roles.responsibility: Design and interpret epidemiological safety evaluations

roles.label: Observational safety study lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate observational safety study delivery and evidence

roles.label: Safety biostatistician
roles.responsibility: Support statistical methods, analyses and interpretation

roles.label: Regulatory intelligence analyst
roles.responsibility: Monitor primary sources and triage changes with evidence

roles.label: Reporting-policy specialist
roles.responsibility: Assess reporting policy, applicability, clocks and exceptions

roles.label: Local regulatory safety expert
roles.responsibility: Interpret local requirements within assigned jurisdiction

roles.label: Safety submission specialist
roles.responsibility: Coordinate submission preparation, routing and acknowledgements

roles.label: Regulatory authority liaison
roles.responsibility: Coordinate authority queries, commitments and responses

roles.label: Safety communications lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate approved safety communications and implementation

roles.label: Safety labeling lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate scientific safety labeling assessments

roles.label: Regulatory labeling specialist
roles.responsibility: Coordinate local implementation and change tracking

roles.label: PV quality manager
roles.responsibility: Coordinate quality governance, metrics and deviations

roles.label: PV auditor
roles.responsibility: Perform assigned audits with appropriate independence

roles.label: CAPA owner
roles.responsibility: Manage corrective/preventive actions and effectiveness evidence

roles.label: Inspection readiness lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate inspection preparation and responses

roles.label: PSMF coordinator
roles.responsibility: Maintain the system description and coordinate documented changes

roles.label: Affiliate safety lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate affiliate safety activities and local oversight

roles.label: Local PV contact / national contact
roles.responsibility: Provide jurisdiction-specific liaison within the applicable local role

roles.label: PV vendor manager
roles.responsibility: Oversee vendor performance, deliverables and escalations

roles.label: Alliance safety lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate partner safety interfaces and responsibilities

roles.label: Safety agreement owner
roles.responsibility: Maintain agreement responsibilities and controlled updates

roles.label: Safety business system owner
roles.responsibility: Own system intended use, priorities and business controls

roles.label: Reporting-rule configuration manager
roles.responsibility: Assess evidence and implement reviewed reporting configurations

roles.label: PV systems / database administrator
roles.responsibility: Maintain authorized configuration and operational support

roles.label: E2B / integration specialist
roles.responsibility: Maintain transmission mappings, interfaces and acknowledgement controls

roles.label: Safety data analyst
roles.responsibility: Analyze data, metrics and reconciliation findings

roles.label: Safety data steward
roles.responsibility: Maintain data definitions and quality ownership

roles.label: Data migration lead
roles.responsibility: Plan migration mappings, reconciliation and evidence

roles.label: Computerised system validation specialist
roles.responsibility: Coordinate risk-based validation and change assurance

roles.label: PV AI / automation governance lead
roles.responsibility: Assess automation performance, limitations and human oversight

roles.label: Terminology / dictionary specialist
roles.responsibility: Govern authorized terminology versions and coding conventions

roles.label: Training & competency lead
roles.responsibility: Coordinate training needs, delivery and competency evidence

roles.label: PV process / SOP owner
roles.responsibility: Maintain assigned procedures, controls and process improvements

roles.label: Knowledge management specialist
roles.responsibility: Maintain controlled knowledge and reference content

roles.label: Medical information liaison
roles.responsibility: Coordinate safety information received through medical information

roles.label: Product quality / complaint liaison
roles.responsibility: Coordinate complaint and potential safety-information exchanges

roles.label: Privacy & records liaison
roles.responsibility: Assess privacy, records and retention interfaces

roles.label: Cybersecurity / access liaison
roles.responsibility: Assess security and access impacts on safety processes

roles.label: Clinical supply / manufacturing liaison
roles.responsibility: Coordinate relevant supply/manufacturing safety information interfaces
